purpose: Preview-only Ubuntu / Kali / Parrot inspired XFCE styles

variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one high fidelity portrait PNG concept of an XFCE desktop theme for Termux Job’s X11 on an Android phone, approximately 1024x2048. This is a desktop-only viewport, not a phone photograph. No device bezel, no outside Android status bar, no app header, no chat composer, no collage. Fill the entire tall canvas with the desktop. Keep the design feasible using XFCE panels, GTK/XFWM decorations, icons and wallpaper, not a fictional OS. Comfortable large readable elements for touch: desktop icons about 72px, bottom launcher icons 56px in an 80px panel, window title buttons 34px. A compact top status/task panel, four shortcuts Home, Terminal, Browser, Trash down the left, one open modest Files window in the upper third with Documents Downloads Pictures folders; leave most central and lower wallpaper visible. Bottom panel has a Menu button with a Termux-style >_ icon (NOT an XFCE mouse and NOT a Windows flag), three roomy launchers Files Terminal Browser and a clock. All border joins continuous, controls neatly rounded without opaque square boxes behind them. Wallpaper typography in the middle, elegant restrained white italic serif, exact three lines ‘Termux-job’s’ then ‘&’ then ‘X11’. English desktop labels only, legible clean UI text. No exploit code, no sensational hacker stock imagery, no fake warnings. This is an original adaptation inspired by the named Linux aesthetic, not a literal screenshot or claim to be the actual distribution. Variant: UBUNTU INSPIRED. Welcoming modern Linux desktop visual language: deep aubergine and purple wallpaper with a tasteful vivid orange sunlit abstract curved landscape, subtle violet gradients, warm charcoal top and bottom panels. Small orange accents on selected tabs and the Menu button, pale gray/ivory Files window interior, dark aubergine rounded title bar, orange folder icons with cream details. Rich but restrained original Ubuntu-like palette, uncluttered professional design, soft shadows, large appealing icons, no Windows styling. Avoid copying official wallpaper or adding a huge Ubuntu logo.
